title: Figure 24. Delta-GEM Simulation Results with B = 1,000 (log-scale line graph)
description: Semi-log line graph titled "Delta-GEM Random-Attitude Failures through 270 sec" plotting Percent in 5-deg sector (%) against Angle From Flight Path (deg), 0–180. Plotted markers show simulated impacts for no breakup and breakup q-alpha of 20,000, 10,000 and 5,000 deg-lb/ft², with theoretical Mode-5 curves for B = 1,000 and A = 1.90, 2.90, 3.10 and 4.30. Captioned "Figure 24. Delta-GEM Simulation Results with B = 1,000".
